name: Single-Arm Lying Dumbbell Extension
research: Same flat-bench body as neutral_grip_dumbbell_press (root (0,0.05,0.55) rot -98 = face-up + the proven 8 deg extra, spine -7/-7/-7/-6; root z = pad 0.44 + ~0.11, estimate, tune with probe_bench). Left arm works (camera yaw +70 = his left side). Upper arm elev 100 / plane 90 = straight up out of the chest, tipped 10 deg toward the head, both poses. du = (0, sin100, -cos100) = (0, 0.985, 0.174); fold toward the head (bend [0,0,1]). Elbow 5 -> 100: elbow at S + 0.29 du = (0.22, 0.29, 0.05); forearm = du cos100 + bperp sin100 = (0, -0.34, 0.94); hand = E + 0.33 fore = (0.22, 0.17, 0.36) torso = beside the ear, 0.17 above the shoulder line. Neutral handle = the fold direction, square to the forearm: start bperp (0, -0.17, 0.98); end rotated 100 deg = (0, -0.94, -0.34) (handle nearly vertical beside the head). Right hand (no prop) rests on the stomach: elev 25, plane 50, elbow 80 folded toward the midline. S1 Boehler 2011 (ACE, upper arm still), S2 Maeo 2023 (shoulder-flexed position), S3 Akima 2021.
